slides.texte_overlay:
How to completely reinvent
the way you think
Question one belief you've had for years. "I'm bad with money." "I'm not a morning person." Many of the limits you live with were never true.
Read one book that disagrees with you. Seeing the other side clearly stretches your mind and makes your own opinions stronger and calmer.
Change your first hour of the day. No phone, a glass of water, a short walk. How you start the morning shapes how you think all day.
Keep a journal for a month. Write what happened and how you reacted. Patterns in your thinking become obvious when you see them on paper.
Feed your mind something new daily. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it slowly changes what I think about.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Little by little, it changes what I think about every single day.

slides.texte_overlay: Do one thing that scares you every week. A hard conversation, a new class, a solo trip. Courage rewires your mind faster than any quote.
Ask "what would the best version of me do?" before big decisions. It's a simple question, but it stops old habits from making choices for you.
